name: ChargeChain SPKLU Revenue Token
description: CHRG is the single asset-backed revenue-share token representing a claim on the operating margin of PLN's high-demand SPKLU electric-vehicle charging network in Indonesia. Principle: one token, tokenize only high-utilization / high-demand assets. Issued via two schemes — (1) Existing · High Utilization: 329 revenue-generating stations (actual operational data, March 2026); (2) Regional · Latent Demand: 324 data-validated recommended points (base scenario ~15.48 GWh/yr). Par value Rp 100,000, target yield 13%. Educational/simulation project — not an investment solicitation.
